description: Owner airframe: AOS 7 V5 7-inch frame, T-Motor F90 2806.5 KV1300 (the 6S 7-inch variant), 7-inch tri-blade props (HQ 7040 used by the vendor thrust table), Holybro Tekko32 F4 Metal 65A 4in1 ESC, 6S LiPo, Jetson Orin Nano, OAK-D S2, Unitree L2. Generated by Tools/Aerial/fit_aos7_profile.py.
evidenceLabel: IMPLEMENTED (not PHYSICALLY_CALIBRATED: no flight log or thrust-stand data of this airframe)
rotorOrder: ArduCopter/PX4 QUAD-X servo order: FR, RL, FL, RR

derived.hover_throttle_note: ESC throttle fraction interpolated from the F90 table (extrapolated below 30%); the model's thrust fraction at hover is (w_h/w_max)^2

TMOTOR_F90.license: vendor web page; numeric measurements cited as facts
TMOTOR_F90.note: Specification and Test Data tables, F90 KV1300 + HQ 7040; live URL now redirects, values read from the 2025-05-24 Wayback snapshot

FAESSLER2018.citation: M. Faessler, A. Franchi, D. Scaramuzza, Differential Flatness of Quadrotor Dynamics Subject to Rotor Drag for Accurate Tracking of High-Speed Trajectories, IEEE RA-L 3(2), 2018
FAESSLER2018.license: paper; model form and order of magnitude cited

CHEESEMAN1955.citation: I. C. Cheeseman, W. E. Bennett, The Effect of the Ground on a Helicopter Rotor in Forward Flight, ARC R&M 3021, 1955

MIL_DRYDEN.citation: MIL-F-8785C (1980) / MIL-HDBK-1797 Dryden low-altitude turbulence model

LIPO_STD.license: CC BY-SA; standard 4.20 V/cell full charge

mass.locator: sum of the itemized component list in 'massBudget' (datasheet items + estimates)

inertia.locator: parallel-axis sum over the component layout in 'massBudget' (boxes, rods, point motors, disc props) about the CoM

kf.locator: relative least-squares T = kf w^2 over the 11-row F90 KV1300 + HQ7040 6S table; max rel residual 0.083, rms 0.050; C_T = 0.165

km.locator: Q = eta P_elec / w with eta = 0.8 (ESTIMATED motor+ESC efficiency); kq fit by relative least squares, km = kq / kf. Electrical power is datasheet; the split is estimated.

tau_up.locator: tau = J/(Kt Ke/R + 2 kq w_hover); J = 2.803e-05 kg m^2 (prop 3 rods 9 g + bell ring 18 g, ESTIMATED), Kt = 60/(2 pi Kv) = 0.00735, R = 76 mOhm (datasheet). Cross-check: PX4 gz x500 uses 12.5 ms up / 25 ms down (SIMULATOR_DEFAULT).

tau_down.locator: same linearisation; AM32 complementary-PWM (active braking) makes the small-signal lag symmetric. Current-limited large steps are not modelled.

rotor_drag.locator: aggregate linear rotor-drag 0.35 1/s x mass, split over 4 rotors at hover speed (F = -|w| lambda1 v_perp). Order of magnitude from the identified rotor-drag coefficients of ~1 kg quadrotors in FAESSLER2018; not identified on this airframe.

rolling_moment.locator: neglected (gz-sim term; no data for 7-inch props)

drag_linear.locator: linear airframe drag is carried by rotor_drag

drag_quadratic.locator: 0.5 rho Cd A with Cd 1.0 (bluff body) and A 0.014 m^2 (frame + L2 + battery + OAK frontal area), rotation-consistent |v| v form

battery_v_empty.locator: 6S x 3.50 V linear-OCV endpoint (real LiPo OCV is non-linear)

battery_v_nominal.locator: bench voltage at which omega_max was measured; omega limit scales with V/V_nom (capped 1)

battery_resistance.locator: 6 cells x ~4 mOhm (100C 1800 mAh class) + leads/connector ~6 mOhm

battery_efficiency.locator: same eta used to split datasheet electrical power into shaft torque, so the model reproduces the datasheet power column (max rel err 0.246)

massBudget.locator: AOS 7 V5 bare-frame mass not retrievable (aos-rc.com is a JS-only Wix site). 170 g total frame is the midpoint of 150-190 g typical for 7-inch 5 mm-arm carbon frames; split 95 g plates/standoffs + 4 x 18.75 g arms.
four 18.75 g rods from hub to motor, see frame_center_plates
F90 KV1300 Weight (Incl. Cable) 46.6 g x 4, at motor positions, z = +0.017 m (half of 34.7 mm height)
HQ 7x4x3 propeller mass ~9 g each (typical 7-inch polycarbonate tri-blade 8-10 g); z = +0.040 m
Tekko32 F4 Metal 4in1 65A ESC Weight 15.8 g, bottom of stack
CubePilot Cube Orange/Orange+ module, 38.25 x 38.25 x 22.3 mm; vendor mass not retrievable from docs.cubepilot.org (no weight published on the pages fetched); 70-80 g aluminium-cased cube class
CubePilot Mini Carrier Board (https://docs.cubepilot.org/user-guides/carrier-boards/mini-carrier-board); no published mass; small 4-layer PCB + connectors 15-25 g
Orin Nano (Super mode) module (69.6 x 45 mm SO-DIMM) + compact carrier + heatsink/fan; NVIDIA dev kit (~176 g with large heatsink) minus oversized carrier; vendor module datasheet requires login
dedicated 12 V regulated branch for the Unitree L2 (6S -> 12 V, 3-5 A buck class 8-15 g)
pMDDL900 brochure Rev 1.2.1: Weight OEM ~7 grams
interface/carrier board for the OEM module (USB/Ethernet + power), no mass published
two 900 MHz dipoles for the 2x2 MIMO pMDDL900, ~10 g each incl. pigtail
FrSky receiver, model not specified by owner; R-XSR/Archer RS class 1.5-6 g incl. antennas
OAK-D S2 Weight 91 g, Dimensions 97 x 29.5 x 22.9 mm; front-mounted facing +x
Unitree 4D LiDAR L2 Weight 230 g; top-mounted above the compute stack
6S 1800 mAh 100C LiPo, 270-300 g class (pack choice not specified by owner); bottom-slung; x solved so the CG lies on the motor centroid (balance_battery)
XT60 + 12 AWG leads, GNSS, standoffs, TPU mounts, straps, Jetson BEC (receiver/radio/regulator itemized)

notes: Ground effect uses Cheeseman-Bennett (CHEESEMAN1955) with rotor_radius; turbulence is Dryden (MIL_DRYDEN) in CraneDrydenTurbulence; neither has an airframe-specific parameter.
Rotor positions are relative to the computed CoM; the CoM offset from the frame centre is in 'derived'.
